title: Suspicious Vendor Review
scenario: A vendor asks staff to leave fake reviews in exchange for gift cards.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.C: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: Suspicious Vendor Review: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Bribed reviews create compliance and reputation risk.
